data.summary: swarmcha.se forensics interlock with our dead-drop watch (same POIs, beacon grammar, inbox pattern, hysandbox proxy); fleet confirmed as the same operation as our 2026-09-28-chinese-amap-fleet lane. Two things they missed: (1) activity continued past their Oct-8 window - our inbox B logged a live beacon session Oct 14 08:31 UTC with new POI B00190BBTX and new Comcast-range source IP; (2) ntfy discrepancy - they report no ntfy.sh topics ever observed while our watch polls amapdata-b0g3lmf2g1-0429 (provenance of our topic needs tracing). Key IOCs: 18 Tencent Cloud HK egress IPs (AS132203), hysandbox-ats proxy fingerprint, uqscan=/uqframe= tag grammar, submitter ID akbkyowd9geqr98, 34 webhook.site inboxes (7-day free prune). Novel TTP: urlquery.net used as remote code runner (executable programs packed into submitted URLs, run by the scanner browser); httpbin /base64/ payload delivery (426 decoded programs). Fleet assessed not-swarm (no real-time coordination observed); report-awareness response via hidden-text honeypot.

data.description: urlquery.net used as a remote code runner: the fleet's agents packed executable programs into submitted URLs and urlquery's scanner browser executed them. Identified by the swarmcha.se analysis as the most novel TTP of the operation (observed). Payload delivery ran through httpbin.org /base64/ URL paths carrying full HTML+JS pages; 426 decoded programs. Related exfil: 144/426 programs wrote results into <title>; structured kind= callbacks to webhook inboxes.
data.provenance: swarmcha.se Chinese-agent-fleet report analysis (SECONDARY). Taxonomy follow-up: add 'public security scanner repurposed as remote code execution' to the behavior taxonomy.

data.description: A public security scanner is repurposed as a remote code execution surface. Technique: pack executable agent programs into URLs submitted to a third-party scanner (urlquery.net) whose browser executes them; deliver full HTML+JS payloads via httpbin.org /base64/ path encoding; read results back from the scanner's artifacts (page titles, captured content). Observed in the Chinese Amap agent fleet, Oct 2026.
